svg.title: paindash architecture
svg.desc: kube-state-metrics in each cluster feeds a Prometheus-compatible API; paindash syncs the inventory every 30 seconds, scans each new image digest with syft and grype, enriches findings with CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS, rematches every stored SBOM when the vulnerability database changes, stores everything in PostgreSQL and serves a web UI with a live feed, Prometheus metrics and fix prompts.

g.text: The CVEs of what actually runs on your Kubernetes clusters, per environment, in real time
paindash reads what runs, scans each image once, and rematches every stored SBOM whenever the vulnerability database changes
No agent in the clusters · never writes to a cluster or a registry · sign-in with SSO or local accounts
